strings.d1.s0.name: Sydney Opera House
strings.d1.s0.tips: Take the 1-hour interior tour (~45 AUD) or admire it from outside; Bennelong Point is best in morning light.
strings.d1.s1.name: Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
strings.d1.s1.tips: Harbourside gardens; Mrs Macquarie's Chair frames the Opera House and the Bridge.
strings.d1.s2.name: The Rocks
strings.d1.s2.tips: Colonial-era stone lanes; weekend market and Cadmans Cottage.
strings.d1.s3.name: The Rocks Cafe
strings.d1.s3.tips: Breakfast or lunch in the Rocks; try the Australian breakfast.
strings.d1.s4.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge Pylon Lookout
strings.d1.s4.tips: 200 steps up the bridge's southeast pylon; a cheap alternative to BridgeClimb (300+ AUD). Walk across the bridge afterwards.
strings.d1.b0.name: Opera Bar
strings.d1.b0.tips: Harbourside bar beneath the Opera House; great at sunset.
strings.d1.b1.name: Museum of Contemporary Art Australia
strings.d1.b1.tips: Free museum at Circular Quay; rooftop cafe.
strings.d2.s0.name: Bondi Beach
strings.d2.s0.tips: A winter morning at 15°C; swimmers at Icebergs and a stroll along the shore.
strings.d2.s1.name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
strings.d2.s1.tips: 6 km of rocky clifftop path past Tamarama, Bronte, Waverley Cemetery and Clovelly.
strings.d2.s2.name: Coogee Pavilion
strings.d2.s2.tips: Rooftop bar and restaurant on Coogee Beach; pizza and seafood.
strings.d2.s3.name: Coogee Beach
strings.d2.s3.tips: Watch the rock pool and take a walk.
strings.d2.s4.name: Bondi Icebergs Sunset
strings.d2.s4.tips: The famous rock pool and beach views; return by bus.
strings.d2.b0.name: Bills Bondi
strings.d2.b1.name: Bronte Baths
strings.d2.b1.tips: Rock pool at Bronte; an alternative to Coogee.
strings.d3.s0.name: Manly Ferry Circular Quay
strings.d3.s0.tips: A 30-minute ferry ride, "the best 8-dollar harbour cruise in the world"; pay with Opal.
strings.d3.s1.name: Manly Beach
strings.d3.s1.tips: Watch the winter surf and stroll the shore.
strings.d3.s2.name: Manly to Spit Bridge Walk
strings.d3.s2.tips: A 10 km harbourside walk with Aboriginal rock carvings and coves (the short version is 1 km to Shelly Beach).
strings.d3.s3.name: Manly Wharf Hotel
strings.d3.s3.tips: Wharfside pub; fish and beer with harbour views.
strings.d3.s4.name: Manly Ferry Sunset Return
strings.d3.s4.tips: The westbound ferry gives you the Opera House and the Bridge at sunset.
strings.d3.b0.name: Shelly Beach Manly
strings.d3.b0.tips: A snorkelling cove; a shorter option than the long walk.
strings.d3.b1.name: Hugos Manly
strings.d3.b1.tips: Pizza and seafood on the wharf.
strings.d4.s0.name: Echo Point Three Sisters
strings.d4.s0.tips: 2 hours by train (Katoomba); free views of the Three Sisters rock formation and the valley.
strings.d4.s1.name: Scenic World Katoomba
strings.d4.s1.tips: The world's steepest railway, a cableway and a rainforest walkway (~55 AUD).
strings.d4.s2.name: Katoomba Yellow Deli
strings.d4.s2.tips: Timber-built cafe in Katoomba; sandwiches and soup.
strings.d4.s3.name: Wentworth Falls Walk
strings.d4.s3.tips: Waterfall and clifftop trail (short section of the National Pass); start from the train station.
strings.d4.s4.name: Leura Village
strings.d4.s4.tips: A charming town with cherry trees and antique shops; take the train back.
strings.d4.b0.name: Leura Garage
strings.d4.b0.tips: Restaurant in a converted garage in Leura.
strings.d4.b1.name: Jenolan Caves
strings.d4.b1.tips: Limestone caves; an alternative to Wentworth Falls (by car).
strings.d5.s0.name: Taronga Zoo Sydney
strings.d5.s0.tips: 12 minutes by ferry; koalas and kangaroos, plus a cable car with harbour views.
strings.d5.s1.name: Taronga Zoo Ferry Wharf
strings.d5.s1.tips: Take the ferry to Darling Harbour or Circular Quay.
strings.d5.s2.name: Darling Harbour
strings.d5.s2.tips: Stroll the waterfront and Pyrmont Bridge.
strings.d5.s3.name: Sydney Fish Market
strings.d5.s3.tips: The Southern Hemisphere's largest fish market; sashimi and oysters straight from the counter, in a new building.
strings.d5.s4.name: Barangaroo Reserve
strings.d5.s4.tips: Harbourside park; sunset and the Wulugul Walk.
strings.d5.b0.name: SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium
strings.d5.b0.tips: Darling Harbour aquarium; an alternative to the zoo.
strings.d5.b1.name: Chinatown Sydney Dixon Street
strings.d5.b1.tips: Dim sum and Chinatown; an alternative to the fish market.
strings.d6.s0.name: Surry Hills Crown Street
strings.d6.s0.tips: Cafes and boutiques; Bourke Street Bakery.
strings.d6.s1.name: Bourke Street Bakery
strings.d6.s1.tips: Sydney's famous bakery; try the ginger brûlée tart and the sausage roll.
strings.d6.s2.name: Paddington Reservoir Gardens
strings.d6.s2.tips: Gardens in a former water reservoir; Oxford Street nearby.
strings.d6.s3.name: Paddington Markets
strings.d6.s3.tips: Saturday market (on other days, browse the boutiques on Oxford Street).
strings.d6.s4.name: Newtown King Street
strings.d6.s4.tips: Street art, vegan cafes and vintage shops; the Enmore Theatre.
strings.d6.b0.name: Mary's Newtown
strings.d6.b0.tips: Burgers and fried chicken in Newtown.
strings.d6.b1.name: Brett Whiteley Studio
strings.d6.b1.tips: The painter's studio in Surry Hills (weekends); an alternative to the reservoir.
strings.d7.s0.name: Watsons Bay Ferry
strings.d7.s0.tips: 30 minutes from Circular Quay; sail towards the harbour entrance.
strings.d7.s1.name: The Gap Lookout
strings.d7.s1.tips: Ocean cliffs; whale watching (May to November).
strings.d7.s2.name: Camp Cove Beach
strings.d7.s2.tips: A winter beach; take a walk.
strings.d7.s3.name: Doyles on the Beach Watsons Bay
strings.d7.s3.tips: A fish restaurant since 1885; a farewell lunch with views of the Opera House.
strings.d7.s4.name: Circular Quay Airport Train
strings.d7.s4.tips: The airport train takes 20 minutes; time to say goodbye.
strings.d7.b0.name: Watsons Bay Boutique Hotel
strings.d7.b0.tips: Beer garden and fish and chips.
strings.d7.b1.name: South Head Heritage Trail
strings.d7.b1.tips: Walk to Hornby Lighthouse; an alternative to the beach.
strings.note0: Pay for ferries, trains and buses with an Opal or contactless card; the Sunday fare cap is low. The airport train takes 20 minutes (surcharge ~17 AUD).
strings.note1: October to April is the warm season (26-30°C from December to February); bring sunscreen for the beach, as UV is very high. The harbour fills up months ahead for New Year's Eve fireworks.
strings.note2: Coffee culture: a flat white costs 5 AUD, brunch 25-30 AUD; fish and chips 20 AUD, a restaurant meal 40+ AUD. Tipping is not expected.
strings.note3: Swim between the flags at beaches (rip currents); the Bondi to Coogee walk is cooler in the morning.
strings.note4: Book the Opera House tour and BridgeClimb online; Taronga offers a combined ferry and entry ticket.
strings.note5: The train from Central to the Blue Mountains takes 2 hours; Scenic World tickets are cheaper online.
strings.transit.name: Opal Card / contactless
strings.transit.why_chosen: Covers trains, ferries, buses and light rail; the Sunday cap is ~9 AUD
